services.name: Lap Swimming
services.desc: The DACA Lap Swim Program is offered for deep water safe adults of all fitness levels. Lap swimmers enjoy the company and encouragement of other adults as well as first class facilities. Year-round lap swimming is offered at Saratoga High School, an outdoor heated pool with mountain views and full locker room access. A DACA coach is on site to supervise during the lap swim program. Participants are able to create their own self-paced workout or pre-written workouts are available from the coach. The facility features a 25 yard by 50 meter Olympic size pool. services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: DACA’s summer water polo camp at Saratoga High School is open to children of all skill levels, ages 7-14. Participants must be able to swim 50 yards (without stopping) and tread water for 1:00 minute. Learn the fundamentals of water polo, including body position, throwing, catching, and shooting in a fun camp environment. Water polo conditioning is also a great way to improve swimming skills! Camp participants should bring a swimsuit, towel, water, sunscreen, and a snack.
